title: Creation of Low-Oxygen Conditions
author: Shengyi Yan
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7hxhj7n

steps.title: Prepare Na2SO3‑supplemented LB
steps.instruction: Prepare LB medium and add sodium sulfite (Na₂SO₃) to obtain the desired range of Na₂SO₃ concentrations; mix thoroughly.

steps.title: Measure dissolved oxygen over time
steps.instruction: Using a dissolved‑oxygen meter, record the dissolved‑oxygen level of each Na₂SO₃‑supplemented LB sample at 0 h, 1 h, 2 h and 5 h.

steps.title: Inoculate bacteria and grow overnight
steps.instruction: Add 50 mL of LB medium and 200 µL of bacterial suspension to a conical flask; incubate with shaking at 37 °C overnight.

steps.title: Harvest cells by centrifugation
steps.instruction: Aliquot 5 mL of the overnight culture into each of five 50 mL centrifuge tubes; centrifuge at 3000 × g, room temperature, for 5 min; discard the supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 5 mL culture to each tube.

steps.title: Add Na2SO3‑LB to cell pellets
steps.instruction: To each tube containing the cell pellet, add LB medium containing the appropriate Na₂SO₃ concentration (as prepared in step 1).

steps.title: Induce with IPTG and incubate
steps.instruction: Add 2 µL of IPTG to each tube, resuspend the pellet, and shake the tubes for 5 h at 37 °C.

steps.title: Measure absorbance at time points
steps.instruction: Using a microplate reader, measure the absorbance of each sample at 0 h, 1 h, 2 h and 5 h.
